Title: Public preview: Azure Communication Services Email

Body.Content:
If you are building communications-enabled applications using Azure Communication Services, you can now add email notifications to your apps. This includes attributes such as account signups, password resets, service outage alerts, purchase confirmations, and more. Software development kits are available for .NET and Javascript. 

Read the blog and learn more.
